about: Help and reporting channels shown by the Citizenship Guide. The model never writes a number or a site; only entries here with verified=true and a verified_by and verified_on value are shown. Fill numbers and links only after checking them at the official source. 'distress' lines replace 'general' when a child expresses distress.

id: Ceritakan ke orang dewasa yang kamu percaya, misalnya orang tua, kakak, atau guru.
Gunakan fitur Laporkan atau Blokir di aplikasi tempat obrolan itu terjadi.
en: Tell an adult you trust, such as a parent, an older sibling or a teacher.
Use the Report or Block feature in the app where the chat happened.

id: Ceritakan perasaanmu hari ini ke orang dewasa yang kamu percaya, misalnya orang tua, kakak, atau guru.
Guru BK atau konselor sekolah bisa diajak bicara secara pribadi.
en: Talk today with an adult you trust, such as a parent, an older sibling or a teacher.
A school counsellor can talk with you privately.
